BiblicalUsage: Mahpekah is the overthrow, the destruction, and it always points back to Sodom. Amos 4:11 says God overthrew some of Israel as He overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and Deuteronomy 29:23 says the whole land shall be like the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboim, while Isaiah 13:19 says Babylon shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Sodom is the measure God keeps returning to, because an overthrow that complete is the clearest picture of what sin earns. My position is that Amos 4:11 is the mercy inside the warning, because Israel was plucked out as a firebrand from the burning, and the overthrow was not the end of them.
